title: Normalization stalk comparison for a supplied root localization
statement: Let L,U be schemes, i:U->L, G a finite group, and W a finite etale G-torsor over U [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]. Let H,B be commutative rings, g in H with (g) prime, B an H-algebra which is the localization at (g). Assume B is a domain and a DVR, and pi=algebraMap H B g is irreducible. Give psi:Spec H->L, k:Spec Frac(B)->U with k;i=j0;Spec(algebraMap H B);psi. Assume the square with top map k, left map the identity of Spec Frac(B), right map i, and bottom map j0;Spec(algebraMap H B);psi is cartesian (hbranch), so this is the entire pullback of U. Give a G-torsor T over Spec Frac(B) and rho:T.P->W.P forming a cartesian square with T.pi,W.pi,k. Write n=|G|, F=X^n-g and F0=F.map(algebraMap H B). Supply the certificate that AdjoinRoot F0, via AdjoinRoot.map, is the localization of AdjoinRoot F at the images of H minus (g). Set A=AdjoinRoot F, N=Spec A, q:N->Spec H, V=D(g), p=pullback.snd(W.pi;i,V.ι;q;psi), and a=p;V.ι. Assume N locally Noetherian, p finite etale and a.fromNormalization finite. Let x be a point of a.normalization over the root prime (t), and supply the contraction equality comap(algebraMap H A,(t))=(g). Set A0=B[s]/(s^n-pi), q0:Spec A0->Spec B, j0:Spec Frac(B)->Spec B, a0=pullback.snd(T.pi;j0,q0), using relative normalization [lem-weil-pbc-relative-normalization]. Then a0 is qcqs, its normalization is finite, and there is x0 over (s) with a ring equivalence from the model normalization stalk at x0 to the original normalization stalk at x. This equivalence carries the structural germ of s to the structural germ of t. The DVR, uniformizer, generic map, and cover are supplied data, not existential conclusions.

proof.text: Register T.isFinite explicitly. The generic spectrum map is affine, so its composite with T.pi is affine. The pullback a0 is qcqs by Mathlib instances. Obtain the cartesian comparison c of root-cover normalizations. Finiteness of a0.fromNormalization follows from this square by finite base change.

Normalize the supplied coefficient-localization certificate to X^n-pi using equality elimination for the defining polynomial (a proved private helper). The contraction equality and the stated root prime imply that its coefficient denominators are disjoint from the image of x. Apply the general affine-localization pullback stalk lemma to the normalization square, obtaining x0 and a structural-germ-preserving ring equivalence.

Evaluate the cartesian square at x0. The resulting prime contraction equality, IsLocalization.map_under, Ideal.map_span and AdjoinRoot.map_root identify the model prime with the span of the root. Specialize the structural-germ identity to the original root and use AdjoinRoot.map_root to prove the required equality.

lean.statement:
theorem root_normalization_localization_comparison
    {L U : Scheme.{u}} (i : U ⟶ L)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G] (W : GaloisCover G U)
    (H B : CommRingCat.{u}) [Algebra H B] (g : H)
    [(Ideal.span {g}).IsPrime] [IsLocalization.AtPrime B (Ideal.span {g})]
    [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    (hpi : Irreducible (algebraMap H B g))
    (ψ : Spec H ⟶ L)
    (k : Spec (CommRingCat.of (FractionRing B)) ⟶ U)
    (hk : k ≫ i = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B (FractionRing B))) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H B)) ≫ ψ)
    (hbranch : IsPullback k (𝟙 _) i
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B (FractionRing B))) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H B)) ≫ ψ))
    (T : GaloisCover G (Spec (CommRingCat.of (FractionRing B))))
    (ρ : T.P ⟶ W.P) (hT : IsPullback ρ T.π W.π k)
    (hrootloc :
      let F := (Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g
      let F0 := F.map (algebraMap H B)
      let γ := AdjoinRoot.map (algebraMap H B) F F0 dvd_rfl
      let := γ.toAlgebra
      IsLocalization ((Ideal.span {g}).primeCompl.map (AdjoinRoot.of F)) (AdjoinRoot F0)) :
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H A))
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H A g)
    ∀ (hN : IsLocallyNoetherian N),
    let := hN
    let p := pullback.snd (W.π ≫ i) (V.ι ≫ q ≫ ψ)
    ∀ (hp : IsFinite p),
    let := hp
    let a := p ≫ V.ι
    Etale p → IsFinite a.fromNormalization →
    ∀ (x : a.normalization),
      (a.fromNormalization x).asIdeal = Ideal.span
        {AdjoinRoot.root ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g)} →
      (Ideal.span {AdjoinRoot.root
        ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g)}).comap
        (algebraMap H A) = Ideal.span {g} →
      let C := a.normalization.presheaf.stalk x
      let t := AlgebraicGeometry.StructureSheaf.toStalk A (a.fromNormalization x)
        (AdjoinRoot.root ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g))
      let pi := algebraMap H B g
      let A0 := AdjoinRoot
        ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C pi)
      let N0 := Spec (CommRingCat.of A0)
      let q0 := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B A0))
      let j0 := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B (FractionRing B)))
      let a0 := pullback.snd (T.π ≫ j0) q0
      ∃ (hqc : QuasiCompact a0) (hqs : QuasiSeparated a0),
        letI := hqc
        letI := hqs
        IsFinite a0.fromNormalization ∧
        ∃ (x0 : a0.normalization),
          (a0.fromNormalization x0).asIdeal = Ideal.span
            {AdjoinRoot.root
              ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C pi)} ∧
          ∃ (e : a0.normalization.presheaf.stalk x0 ≃+* C),
            e ((a0.fromNormalization.stalkMap x0).hom
              (AlgebraicGeometry.StructureSheaf.toStalk A0 (a0.fromNormalization x0)
                (AdjoinRoot.root
                  ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C pi)))) =
              (a.fromNormalization.stalkMap x).hom t

old_proof.text: Use the supplied root-algebra localization certificate. The coefficientwise image of X^n-g is X^n-pi, and AdjoinRoot.map sends the root to the root. The supplied contraction equality ensures that the root prime avoids all inverted coefficient elements.

Identify Spec B -> Spec H with the stalk morphism at (g), using the affine spectrum stalk localization equivalence. Apply lem-sbc-normalization-stalk-base-change to q:N->Spec H and a. Pullback associativity, the supplied generic compatibility hk, and the supplied cartesian square hT identify the localized source with the model pullback of T. A DVR uniformizer has D(pi)=Spec Frac(B), so this is the same punctured cover. The model map is qcqs, and its normalization is finite by base change and transport of the original finite normalization.

Extend the root prime under the localization; it is the root ideal (s), since the coefficient map carries g to pi and the quotient localization carries t to s. Lift the given normalization point into the cartesian base change, and transport it across the normalization isomorphism to x0. Localization gives an isomorphism of stalks at these corresponding points because every denominator is already a unit. Compose with the normalization stalk isomorphism. Both maps commute with the structural algebra maps, and the root-algebra localization sends t to s. Naturality of stalk maps and structural germs gives the displayed root equality.
